key_points: Boeing's reported $7.4 billion China jet order is a positive signal for its commercial aerospace backlog and China recovery narrative.
Mizuho's bullish defense-sector call adds positive sentiment around Boeing as an underappreciated defense and aerospace name.
Trump's expectation of another 250 China orders is supportive but speculative and policy-dependent.
The stock already moved higher on the news, meaning some of the near-term positive catalyst may be priced in.
Long-term risk remains due to execution, geopolitical exposure, and reliance on China order conversions.
